en: The image depicts a color photograph of a mid-century modern hotel building with balconies and a lush green garden in the foreground. Several people are seen walking on a path beside the hotel. The hotel sign on the roof reads 'Хотел Изгрев' in Cyrillic. The reverse side of the postcard contains multilingual text (Bulgarian, English, French, German), official library stamps, and a handwritten note. The languages and architecture suggest an Eastern European resort, specifically Bulgarian.
